purpose: Stress-tests the one-token-equals-one-share economic-exposure claim for Robinhood Chain stock tokens against actual redemption reachability. BBVI is the sole Authorised Participant at issuance; only Authorised Participants may subscribe or redeem directly from Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited after KYB, everyone else is secondary-market-only. Enumerates AP concentration, premium/discount exposure if the sole AP stops market-making, and issuer-credit exposure distinct from the underlying equity. Verify-only; never recommends a position. Zero network, zero PII.
